notes: Adds a Legacy Name Check tool to Customer Cleanup (flags contacts filed under the wrong name from the old import), lets pets be edited (name/breed) directly from Manage a Client, and adds pet checkboxes to Print History that filter what's printed AND what the appointment table/Delete Selected/Delete All act on. Also renamed the product from 'Bayfront Automation Kennel Utility' to 'Bayfront Automation Grooming Center' -- display names and the installer/service branding only, no functional changes.
